content_sections.text: Qualification: MEO Class I Certificate issued under Merchant Shipping Act, 1958 with 5 years experience as Chief Engineer or 5 years combined experience as Chief Engineer and 2nd Engineer on board a Foreign-going ship / Trailer Suction Hopper Dredger. Age limit: As per Recruitment Rules (as on 1 February 2027) Other conditions: Employed in any Major Port

content_sections.heading: SMPK Deputy Manager (Marine Engineering) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Deputy Manager (Marine Engineering) under the Marine Operations Division of Haldia Dock Complex oversees marine engineering functions, manages port vessels, dredgers, and associated machinery operations, ensures compliance with maritime regulations, and maintains operational readiness of port marine assets as per the administrative requirements of SMPA.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation will be initially for 03 years, extendable up to 04 years and in exceptional circumstances up to 05 years.

content_sections.heading: How Will SMPK Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection by merit APAR grading benchmark not below Good Selection is by merit with benchmark in overall grading in APARs not below Good.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Copies of APARs for the last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26) attested by Dy. HOD Self-certified photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, present and past work experience No objection certificate issued by the competent authority from respective Port Undertaking of the applicant not to withdraw candidature Vigilance and administrative clearance Two passport size colour photographs Complete service details certified by an Officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SMPK Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Send application in the prescribed proforma through proper channel. Superscribe the envelope with 'Application for the post of Dy. Manager (Marine Engineering) under Marine Operations Division, HDC, SMPA on Absorption / Deputation'. Send to the office of Sr. Dy. Manager (P&IR), Jawahar Tower, P.O. — Haldia Township, Dist. — Purba Medinipur, W.B. PIN - 721607 on or before December 15, 2026. Make sure it reaches by 15 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Crucial date of determining eligibility will be 01.02.2027. Advance copy will not be considered if application is not received through proper channel by the last date.
